ei.title: 브랜드화의 역할: 인지도를 통한 소비자의 위험 감소
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both ①<u>benefit</u> from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer ②<u>learns</u> to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this ③<u>tends</u> to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation ④<u>reduce</u> the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ reduce → reduces: 주어 This expectation이 3인칭 단수이므로 동사에 -s를 붙여 reduces가 맞다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① benefit(동사): 주어 'Customers and organisations(복수)'에 맞는 복수 동사로 적절
✅ ② learns(동사): 주어 'a customer(단수)'에 맞는 3인칭 단수 동사로 적절
✅ ③ tends(동사): 주어 'this(단수)'에 맞는 3인칭 단수 동사로 적절
❌ ④ reduce → reduces: 이 동사의 주어는 'This expectation(이러한 기대)'으로 3인칭 단수예요. 단수 주어에는 동사에 -s를 붙여야 하므로 reduce가 아니라 reduces가 맞아요 ←정답
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어(This expectation) + 동사 -s. expectation reduces(O)

If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what ④<u>to expect</u> from any of their hotels worldwide. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ to lowering → to lower: 'to + 동사원형'이므로 to 뒤에는 동사원형 lower가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① to recognise: 'learns to recognise(알아보는 법을 배우다)'에서 to부정사로 적절
✅ ② to be comfortable: 'likely to be(편안해질 것 같다)'에서 to부정사로 적절
❌ ③ to lowering → to lower: 'tends to ___(~하는 경향이 있다)'는 'to + 동사원형' 구조예요. to 뒤에는 -ing가 아니라 동사원형이 와야 하므로 to lower가 맞아요 ←정답
✅ ④ to expect: 'what to expect(무엇을 기대할지)'에서 '의문사 + to부정사'로 적절
det.tip: to부정사 = to + 동사원형. tends to lower(O) / to lowering(X)

With experience a customer learns to recognise ①<u>preferred</u> (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower ②<u>perceived risk</u>. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a ③<u>branded chain</u> of hotels that are ④<u>globally recognising</u>. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ recognising → recognised: 'are + 과거분사'의 수동태이므로 과거분사 recognised가 맞다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① preferred(과거분사): 'preferred brands(선호되는 브랜드)'에서 명사를 꾸미는 과거분사로 적절
✅ ② perceived risk(과거분사+명사): 'perceived risk(인지된 위험)'에서 과거분사가 risk를 꾸며 적절
✅ ③ branded chain(과거분사+명사): 'a branded chain(브랜드화된 체인)'에서 과거분사가 chain을 꾸며 적절
❌ ④ recognising → recognised: 'hotels that are globally ___'은 호텔이 '인지되는' 것이므로 수동태(be + 과거분사)가 필요해요. 그래서 -ing가 아니라 과거분사 recognised가 맞아요 ←정답
det.tip: be + 과거분사 = 수동태. are globally recognised(O) / recognising(X)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels ①<u>that are globally</u> recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of ②<u>what to expect</u> from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups ③<u>is what they will deliver</u> a level of service ④<u>that consumers would recognise</u> worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ is what → is that: 뒤에 완전한 절(they will deliver ~)이 오므로 접속사 that이 맞다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① that are globally: 'hotels that are globally recognised'에서 선행사 hotels를 받는 주격 관계대명사 that으로 적절
✅ ② what to expect: 'what to expect(무엇을 기대할지)'에서 '의문사 + to부정사'로 적절
❌ ③ is what → is that: 'the brand promise ... is ___ they will deliver a level of service'에서 뒤에 빠진 것 없는 완전한 절(they will deliver ~)이 이어져요. 완전한 절 앞에는 '~라는 것'을 뜻하는 접속사 that이 와야 하므로 what은 부적절 ←정답
✅ ④ that consumers would recognise: 'a level of service that consumers would recognise'에서 선행사 service를 받는 목적격 관계대명사 that으로 적절
det.tip: 뒤에 완전한 절 → 접속사 that. 뒤에 불완전한 절(빠진 자리) → what

This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or ③<u>additional</u> comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This ④<u>expectation</u> reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 comfortable(편안한)인데 anxious(불안한)로 바꿈. 브랜드를 경험하면 그 브랜드에 '편안해진다'는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① important(중요한): 인지가 '중요한' 특징이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② anxious(불안한) → comfortable(편안한): 브랜드를 경험하고 나면 그 브랜드에 '편안해진다'는 문맥이므로 anxious는 정반대 ←정답
✅ ③ additional(추가적인): '추가적인' 편안함이라는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ expectation(기대): '이러한 기대'가 위험을 줄인다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: comfortable(편안한) ↔ anxious(불안한)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both ①<u>benefit</u> from branding. From the customer perspective, ②<u>recognition</u> is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a ③<u>good indication</u> of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation ④<u>increases the risk</u> of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 reduces(줄이다)인데 increases(늘리다)로 바꿈. 기대가 여행 중 위험을 '줄인다'는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① benefit(이득을 얻다): 고객과 기업 모두 '이득을 얻는다'는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② recognition(인지): 고객 입장에서 '인지'가 중요하다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ good indication(좋은 짐작): 무엇을 기대할지에 대한 '좋은 짐작'이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ increases the risk(위험을 늘리다) → reduces the risk(위험을 줄이다): 브랜드에 대한 기대가 여행 중 불쾌한 놀라움의 위험을 '줄인다'는 문맥이므로 increases는 정반대 ←정답
det.tip: reduces the risk(위험을 줄이다) ↔ increases the risk(위험을 늘리다)

questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"브랜드화는 고객과 기업 양쪽 모두에게 이득을 준다."

det.korean: T: 본문 첫 문장 'Customers and organisations both benefit from branding'과 일치.
det.analysis:
본문: 'Customers and organisations both benefit from branding.'
고객과 기업 모두 브랜드화에서 이득을 얻는다는 진술과 일치 → T
det.tip: both A and B benefit = A와 B 모두 이득을 얻다

다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"소비자는 브랜드를 경험하기도 전에 이미 그 브랜드에 편안함을 느낀다."

det.korean: F: 본문은 브랜드를 '경험한 뒤에(once they have experienced)' 편안해진다고 했다.
det.analysis:
본문: 'once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand'
편안함은 브랜드를 '경험한 뒤에' 생기는 것이지 경험 전이 아니므로 진술과 불일치 → F
det.tip: once they have experienced ~ = 일단 ~을 경험하고 나면(경험이 먼저)

"브랜드에 대한 기대는 여행 중 불쾌한 일이 생길 위험을 줄여 준다."

본문: 'This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip.'

det.tip: reduce the risk of unpleasant surprises = 불쾌한 일이 생길 위험을 줄이다

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower __________. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 인지된 위험(perceived risk). 브랜드에 편안해지면 소비자가 느끼는 '인지된 위험'이 낮아진다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① perceived risk(인지된 위험): 브랜드에 편안해지면 소비자가 느끼는 위험이 낮아진다는 흐름에 적절. 뒤에서도 'reduces the risk'로 위험 이야기가 이어짐 ←정답

❌ ② production costs(생산 비용): 생산 비용은 글에서 다루지 않음

❌ ③ physical distance(물리적 거리): 거리는 글의 논지와 무관

❌ ④ market competition(시장 경쟁): 시장 경쟁은 본문에 등장하지 않음
det.tip: 빈칸 뒤·다음 문장이 모두 '위험(risk)'을 다룸 → 인지된 위험

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has __________ from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 무엇을 기대할지에 대한 좋은 짐작(a good indication of what to expect). 여행자는 어느 지점에서든 이것을 갖는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a legal contract with the staff(직원과의 법적 계약): 계약은 글에서 다루지 않음

✅ ② a good indication of what to expect(무엇을 기대할지에 대한 좋은 짐작): 여행자가 어느 지점에서든 무엇을 기대할지 잘 알기에 위험이 줄어든다는 흐름에 부합. 뒤 문장의 '기대(expectation)'와 연결됨 ←정답

❌ ③ a discount on every booking(모든 예약 할인): 할인은 본문에 없음

❌ ④ a personal tour guide(개인 여행 가이드): 가이드는 본문에 등장하지 않음
det.tip: 뒤 문장 'This expectation'이 빈칸의 '기대'를 받음 → 무엇을 기대할지에 대한 짐작

ch: a legal contract with the staff
a good indication of what to expect

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ② 브랜드 약속 = 전 세계 소비자가 알아볼 서비스 제공 — 본문 마지막 문장과 일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 고객은 '선호 브랜드뿐 아니라 비선호 브랜드도(preferred as well as non-preferred)' 알아본다고 했으므로 '선호하는 것만'은 틀림

✅ ② 'the brand promise ... is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide'와 일치 ←정답

❌ ③ 본문은 반드시 더 나은 가치 때문은 아니라고(not necessarily) 했으므로 '언제나 더 낮은 가격'은 틀림

❌ ④ 첫 문장에서 고객과 기업 '모두' 이득을 얻는다고 했으므로 '기업에게만'은 틀림
det.tip: 일치 문제는 본문이 긍정한 내용을 고른다. 나머지는 본문을 뒤집은 것

ch: 고객은 경험을 통해 선호하는 브랜드만 알아보게 된다.
브랜드 약속은 전 세계 소비자가 알아볼 만한 수준의 서비스를 제공하는 것이다.
글로벌 호텔 체인은 언제나 더 낮은 가격을 제공한다.

For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
